## Description

A semantic `geometric_tolerance` (e.g., perpendicularity) loses its associativity with the toleranced `advanced_face` after translation, or its graphical presentation drifts off the part. Multi-surface GTOL refs lose entries on AP242 round-trip. Notes and surface symbols partially-write semantic_designation links.

## Reproducer recipe

`perpendicularity_tolerance` with `geometric_tolerance.toleranced_shape_aspect → advanced_face`; presentation `draughting_callout` with annotation curves; round-trip and check the chain integrity.

## Expected kernel behavior

Preserve associativity links; never silently drop the toleranced_shape_aspect chain. Round-trip semantic_designation links between annotations and surfaces.
